brief: Native Android anime streaming application with embedded high-performance Rust daemon, 120Hz fluid motion, AniSkip smart intro/outro skipping, and OLED aesthetics.

concepts.name: The Chrono Eye
concepts.idea: An aerodynamic almond eye aperture integrated with an exact 30° equilateral play triangle pupil.
rationale: Directly embodies the Japanese meaning of '見る' (Miru, to watch) while universally communicating streaming playback.
Built strictly from pure geometric primitives, audited at 100/100 production score with zero near-miss angles.
Scales effortlessly down to 16px for favicons and status bars, with powerful presence as an Android app tile.

recommendation: The Chrono Eye is the definitive brand identity for Miru, achieving instant recognition and category leadership.
